finance.validation.allocation_exceeds_pa: The allocation exceeds what this payment put on the order.
finance.validation.allocation_exceeds_du: An installment cannot receive more than it lacks.
finance.summary.proofs_pending: :count customer receipt(s) under review, not counted
finance.excess.title: Unallocated money:
finance.excess.body: Collected above the agreement: it needs allocation to another order or a refund (settlement). It does not raise the agreement.
finance.excess.deposit: A deposit before the agreement: it is allocated when the agreement is approved, without a new receipt.
finance.shortfall.title: A completed collection check is no longer covered
finance.shortfall.body: After a correction the collected amount is below: :checks. The completed stage stays; decide what to do.
finance.proofs.title: Customer receipts waiting
finance.proofs.description: A customer's receipt is not money until confirmed.
finance.proofs.cancel_description: Nothing is collected; the file stays in the order's record.
finance.schedule.heading: Payment schedule
finance.schedule.title: Edit the payment schedule
finance.schedule.description: The sum never exceeds the agreement.
finance.schedule.empty_body: The schedule appears when the agreement is approved. A deposit can be recorded before.
finance.schedule.empty_agreed: The schedule was emptied; add installments to collect.
finance.schedule.complete: The schedule is complete and equals the agreement.
finance.schedule.name: Installment name
finance.schedule.reference_hint: Matches the flow's collection check (first, final).
finance.schedule.note_paid: A paid installment or a linked invoice never changes silently.
finance.schedule.note_rounding: The last installment takes any rounding difference.
finance.payments.title: Collected
finance.payments.description: Every confirmed amount has a numbered receipt and is allocated to the oldest installments.
finance.conditions.title: Stage collection checks
finance.conditions.description: Compared with the net collected; a receipt under review never counts.
finance.conditions.none: The order's flow has no collection check.
finance.record.title: Record a payment for :order
finance.record.description: A numbered receipt is issued on saving, with no second approval.
finance.record.allocated_oldest: Allocated to the oldest installments; the rest stays unallocated.
finance.record.reference_hint: The same reference is never recorded twice.
finance.record.evidence_hint: Transfer advice, card slip or a photo of the cheque.
finance.record.evidence_required: Attach the proof of the payment.
finance.record.split_order: Part for another order of the customer
finance.record.split_hint: Optional: one transfer for two orders.
finance.record.acknowledge_similar: This is a different payment, not the one already recorded
finance.record.note_receipt: The receipt reaches the customer by SMS.
finance.record.note_same_transfer: If the customer uploaded this transfer, confirm it from their receipt instead.
finance.review.title: Review the customer's receipt
finance.review.received_hint: If it differs, only the received amount is recorded and the customer is told.
finance.review.matching: This transfer is already recorded (receipt :receipt): confirming links it, no new receipt.
finance.review.similar: A payment with the same amount was recorded recently: check it is not the same transfer.
finance.review.note_receipt: Confirming issues one numbered receipt and meets the collection check.
finance.review.note_difference: The two amounts are never counted together.
finance.correction.title: Ask the customer to correct the receipt
finance.correction.description: The receipt is not counted and the amount stays due. The customer sees your reason.
finance.transfer.title: Move unallocated money of :order
finance.transfer.note: Same customer only; no new receipt. The refundable balance of this order goes down.
finance.reallocate.title: Allocation of :receipt
finance.reallocate.description: Never more than the payment or than an installment lacks; the rest stays unallocated.
finance.home.title: Finance: follow-up
finance.home.description: What is due, overdue or waiting for a decision, oldest first.
finance.home.empty_body: No due, overdue or waiting receipt in your scope.
finance.reminder.title: Send a reminder to :count customer(s)?
finance.reminder.description: Each customer gets their own order and amount only, on the channel they have. Amounts are checked again when sending.
finance.report.title: Collection report
finance.report.description: Collections, dues and their ages from confirmed payments only.
finance.message.subject: Payment notice from :facility
finance.message.receipt: Receipt :number: we received :amount SAR for order :order. Thank you.
finance.message.proof_correction: Your transfer receipt for order :order needs a correction: :reason
finance.message.proof_amount: For order :order we received :received SAR (your receipt shows :claimed SAR). Only the received amount is recorded.
finance.message.due_soon: Reminder: :due of order :order (:amount SAR) is due soon.
finance.message.due_overdue: Reminder: :due of order :order (:amount SAR) is overdue.
notifications.type.finance_proof_submitt: The customer uploaded a transfer of :amount SAR.
notifications.type.finance_late_gateway_: The provider confirmed :reference after it was closed here. Decide how to settle it.
audit.action.finance.credit_transferred: Unallocated money moved to another order
audit.action.finance.proof_correction_re: Correction requested on a customer receipt
commissions.title: Finance: commissions
commissions.description: Commission on what was actually collected, after discount and before VAT.
commissions.policy_off: Commissions are off; new sales are pinned at 0%.
commissions.empty: No commissioned sales in your scope
commissions.empty_body: A sale appears here once its order's agreement is approved.
commissions.held_hint: Held amounts belong only to orders with an open settlement, refund or dispute. A negative difference after a payout is carried, never deducted from a salary.
commissions.statement_hint: Current rate :rate for new sales; every sale keeps its pinned rate.
commissions.basis_hint: Commission = eligible products after discount and before VAT × rate × (allocated collected ÷ agreed value). A proof under review and unallocated money do not count.
commissions.entry.transfer_out: Moved to the new sale owner
commissions.entry.transfer_in: Moved from the previous sale owner
commissions.owner_source.creator: Order creator
commissions.payout.title: Pay out :name's commission?
commissions.payout.description: Records a payout made outside OpsOne with a method, reference and proof.
commissions.payout.held_out: Held orders left out of this payout: :count
commissions.payout.note_recheck: On saving the available balance is checked again; a refund or dispute that just happened is held first.
commissions.payout.note_negative: A later refund or cancellation adds a carried negative difference and never erases this payout.
commissions.payout.cancel_hint: Nothing was paid; the hold is released and the reason kept.
commissions.payout.correct_hint: Record what really left with a reason and proof; the original payout stays.
commissions.payout.reserved_done: Payout approved and its lines reserved
commissions.sale.title: Sale owner and commission
commissions.sale.description: One sale owner with the rate pinned at the agreement; a correction is a financial decision with a reason that never rewrites history.
commissions.sale.none: The sale is not pinned yet
commissions.sale.none_body: It is pinned when the order's first agreement is approved.
commissions.corrections.title: Correction requests
commissions.corrections.request_hint: Approved by someone else authorized who is not affected; the accrual moves by a reversal and an addition and paid amounts stay.
commissions.settings.title: Commission
commissions.settings.hint: A simple rate policy; it applies to new sales only.
commissions.settings.default_hint: 0 to 100; a member's or role's rate takes precedence.
commissions.settings.manual_lines: Hand-typed lines count when marked commissionable
commissions.settings.manual_hint: Fees and delivery are marked non-commissionable in the quote.
commissions.settings.invalid: Check the rates: 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.
commissions.settings.p95_only: Editable by whoever manages the commission policy.
commissions.settings.no_retro: Never retroactive: every sale keeps its pinned rate.
finance.condition.own_payout: Nobody records a payout to themselves.
finance.condition.payout_open: This member has an open payout; finish or withdraw it first.
finance.condition.not_from_draft: The payout is still a draft.
finance.condition.not_from_reserved: The payout is reserved awaiting execution.
finance.condition.own_sale: Nobody decides on their own commission.
finance.condition.own_request: Someone other than the requester approves the correction.
finance.condition.correction_open: This order already has an open correction request.
finance.condition.no_sale: The sale is not pinned yet.
finance.condition.no_change: Nothing differs from the current sale.
agreements.settings.cash_proof_hint: Decided by the facility owner. Transfers, cards and cheques always need a proof.
agreements.settings.cash_proof_required: A cash collection needs a proof file
finance.record.cash_proof_optional: Optional for cash by the owner's setting; without a file, write the reason in the note.
finance.record.cash_note_required: Write why there is no proof in the note.
finance.validation.cash_note_required: A cash collection without a proof needs a note with the reason.
